blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.
blocks.zh: 现有大视野语言 示范基准主要评价一般日常情况下的视觉理解,使历史与特定时代保持一致,国家在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出Anachro Bench,这是评价视觉场景历史一致性的可控歧视基准。 它包含了由从19世纪后期到20世纪初的8个国家出产的1600个图像对相,每个图像将一个原始的历史图像与一个不合时代的版本相配,包含一个无缝插入的现代物体. Anachro Bench评价了三个方面: 插入对象感知,测试模型是否检测被插入的现代对象; 时代-国家一致性,评估场景是否符合指定的时代和国家; 有条件的时代-国家一致性,仅在被插入对象被正确感知时测量一致性判断. 当一个模型认为现代物体但仍然判断该场景具有历史一致性时,就会产生错误的一致性判断。 总之,Anachro Bench揭示了插入对象感知与时代国家一致性判断之间的差距,为这种行为提供了有针对性的评价.

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) [ 24 ] integrated with visual encoders have led to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), demonstrating strong performance in visual question answering and image captioning [ 3 , 7 , 21 , 22 , 31 , 33 ] . Despite these advances, models may accurately perceive individual visual elements while failing to determine their compatibility with the broader temporal or geographic context, producing plausible but inconsistent responses [ 4 , 17 , 20 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)[24]与视觉编码器集成,导致大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs),在视觉问题解答和图像字幕[3,7,21,22,31,33]中表现出强烈的性能. 尽管取得了这些进展,但模型可能准确地认识了单个视觉要素,同时又无法确定它们与更广泛的时间或地理背景的兼容性,从而得出了可信但不一致的答复[4、17、20、27]。

blocks.en: LVLM evaluation has evolved from object existence [ 20 , 27 ] to object attributes and relations, visual illusions [ 6 , 13 , 18 , 29 ] , and commonsense consistency [ 5 , 15 , 23 ] . However, existing benchmarks predominantly address everyday scenarios independent of specific eras or locations. Century [ 1 ] and TAB-VLM [ 26 ] evaluate historical contextualization and period reasoning on original images, but do not directly evaluate whether a scene is consistent with an explicitly specified era and country.
blocks.zh: LVLM评价从对象存在[20,27]演变为对象属性和关系,视觉错觉[6,13,18,29],以及常识一致性[5,15,23]. 然而,现有基准主要针对不同时代或地点的日常情况。 Century [1] 和 TAB-VLM [26] 在原始图像上评价历史背景和时期推理,但不直接评价一个场景是否符合一个明确规定的时代和国家.

blocks.en: Visual consistency depends on historical context: even within the same country, objects natural in the 1900s differ from those of today. Assessing consistency therefore requires recognizing visual entities and reconciling them with the provided context. When LVLMs screen or curate historical image collections, such as AI-generated period imagery [ 9 ] or mislabeled historical photographs, their consistency judgments are reliable only if they follow from the evidence the model itself perceives.
blocks.zh: 视觉一致性取决于历史背景:即使在同一个国家内部,1900年代的自然物体也与今天不同. 因此,评估一致性需要确认视觉实体,并将其与所提供的背景相协调。 LVLMs筛选或整理历史图像集,如AI生成的时期图像[9]或错误标记的历史照片时,其一致性判断只有在从模型本身感知到的证据中遵循时才可靠.

blocks.en: To examine how models use visual evidence in historical-context judgments, we propose AnachroBench , a controlled discriminative benchmark. Figure 1 illustrates a model identifying a drone yet accepting the edited scene as consistent with France during 1870–1919. We call this a false consistency judgment : an edited scene is accepted as consistent even after the inserted object has been perceived. This setting tests how perceived object evidence informs context-dependent decisions rather than relying on spontaneous free-form generation.
blocks.zh: 为了研究模型如何在历史-文字判断中使用视觉证据,我们提出Anachro Bench,一个可控的歧视性基准. 图1显示一种模式,识别一架无人机,但接受经编辑的场景与法国在1870-1919年期间一致。 我们称之为错误的一致判断:即使被插入的对象被感知后,编辑过的场景也被接受为一致. 这种设定测试了感知对象证据如何为上下文决定提供依据,而不是依赖自发的自由形式生成.

blocks.en: We collected historical images from eight countries spanning the late 19th to early 20th century and inserted modern objects to create anachronistic counterparts. Human validation of insertion position, size, and appearance yielded 1,600 original–anachronistic pairs. Finally, we evaluate three aspects: Inserted Object Perception , Era-Country Consistency , and Conditional Era-Country Consistency .
blocks.zh: 我们收集了从19世纪末到20世纪初的八个国家的历史图像,并插入了现代物体,以制造不合时代的对应物。 人类对插入位置、大小和外观的验证产生了1,600对原创的-不合时宜的对子。 最后,我们评价三个方面: 插入对象感知 , 时代- 国家一致性 , 和有条件的时代- 国家一致性 。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1) AnachroBench, a controlled benchmark of historical consistency across eight countries; (2) evaluation of 14 open-source and four closed-source LVLMs on the three metrics; and (3) analyses of perception–consistency gaps, examining evidence use and the effect of explicit object-timing information.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是: (1) Anachro Bench, 8个国家历史一致性的可控基准;(2) 评价14个开放源代码和4个封闭源代码的LVLM的3个衡量标准;(3) 分析认知-一致性差距,审查证据使用情况和明确的目标刺激信息的效果。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Large Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 大型远景-语言模型

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison with representative LVLM benchmarks. Context indicates the use of era/country information. Task types are abbreviated as Disc. for discriminative and Gen. for generative.
blocks.zh: 表1:与LVLM代表性基准的比较。 背景表明使用时代/国家信息。 任务类型缩写为Disc,用于歧视,Gen用于基因.

blocks.en: The rapid evolution of LLMs has driven the development of LVLMs, which integrate visual encoders with language decoders to enable strong multimodal instruction-following capabilities. Open-source LVLMs include LLaVA [ 22 ] , InstructBLIP [ 8 ] , mPLUG-Owl2 [ 33 ] , CogVLM2 [ 16 ] , InternVL3.5 [ 31 ] , Gemma 3 [ 11 ] , and Llama-3.2-Vision [ 12 ] ; closed-source systems include GPT-4o [ 25 ] , Gemini 2.5 [ 7 ] , and Claude Sonnet [ 2 ] . Despite this progress, LVLMs may still produce responses inconsistent with visual evidence or fail to incorporate perceived evidence into contextual judgments.
blocks.zh: LLMs的快速演变推动了LVLMs的开发,LVLMs将视觉编码器与语言解码器融合在一起,从而能够具备强大的多式联运指令跟随能力. 开源LVLM包括LLAVA [22],IstructBLIP [8],mPLUG-Owl2 [33],CogVLM2 [16],InternVL3.5 [31],Gemma 3 [11],以及Llama-32-Vision [12];闭源系统包括GPT-4o [25],双子座2.5 [7],以及克劳德·索内[2]. 尽管取得了这一进展,LVLMs仍然可能产生与视觉证据不一致的答复,或未能将所见证据纳入相关判决。

blocks.en: 2.2 LVLM Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 低压 评价基准

blocks.en: Early LVLM benchmarks such as CHAIR [ 27 ] and POPE [ 20 ] focused on verifying the presence of isolated objects. HallusionBench [ 13 ] tests answer consistency on original–edited pairs, ROPE [ 6 ] and THRONE [ 18 ] evaluate multi-object and free-form object hallucination, and ROHE [ 15 ] , PhD [ 23 ] , and ODE [ 29 ] add object removal, prompted questions, and open-set evaluation. COinCO [ 32 ] inpaints out-of-context objects, whereas its context is defined by location, size, and co-occurrence in everyday scenes. Century [ 1 ] evaluates free-form historical contextualization of geographically diverse images, TAB-VLM [ 26 ] measures cultural anachronism through period questions on Indian artifacts, and HistVis [ 9 ] examines anachronistic objects in text-to-image outputs. AnachroBench instead uses controlled object insertion into real photographs and discriminative evaluation to test whether correctly perceived evidence is incorporated into a judgment about an explicitly specified era and country (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 早期LVLM基准,如ChaIR[27]和POPE[20],侧重于验证孤立物体的存在. Hallusion Bench [13] 测试在原始编辑的对子,ROPE [6] 和THRONE [18] 上解答一致性,评价多对象和自由形式的物体幻觉,ROHE [15],博士 [23],ODE [29] 加上对象清除,引发问题,以及开放设置的评价. COinCO [32] 涂装出文字对象,而其上下文则根据位置,大小,以及日常场景中的共犯来定义. Century [1] 评估地理多样性图像的自由形式历史背景,TAB-VLM [26] 通过印度文物的时期问题衡量文化时代,HistVis [9] 在文本到图像输出中考察不合时代的物体. 相反,Anachro Bench使用在真实照片中插入受控物体和歧视性评价来检验是否将正确感知的证据纳入关于一个明确规定的时代和国家的判决(表1)。

blocks.en: 3 AnachroBench Evaluation Suite
blocks.zh: 3 Anachro Bench 评价套件

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准建设

blocks.en: We used three Gemini models : gemini-3-flash-preview for filtering and object selection, gemini-3.1-pro-preview for anachronistic object classification, and gemini-2.5-flash-image for compositing (prompts in Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 我们使用了三种双子座模型:用于过滤和对象选择的双子座-3-flash-preview,用于过时对象分类的双子座3.1-pro-preview,以及用于堆肥的双子座-2.5-flash-image(附录B中的提示).

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Data Collection and Filtering
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 数据收集和过滤

blocks.en: We collected 8,456 historical photographs from Wikimedia Commons , the New York Public Library (NYPL) , the Library of Congress (LoC) , and GongU Madang , a Korean public-domain archive (source breakdown in Appendix C.2 ). Images cover Germany (DE), United States (US), Netherlands (NL), France (FR), Russia (RU), Korea (KR), China (CN), and Japan (JP) during 1870–1929, a period that predates the inserted objects and offers abundant public-domain photographs with reliable date and location metadata. We retained images whose licenses or rights statements permit modification and redistribution, including Public Domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA, and CC0. The image pairs, metadata, and evaluation prompts will be made publicly available.
blocks.zh: 纽约公共图书馆(NYPL)、国会图书馆(LOC)和韩国公共领域档案馆GongU Madang(来源:附录C.2)收集了8 456张历史照片。 图像涵盖1870-1929年期间德国(DE)、美国(United States)、荷兰(NL)、法国(FR)、俄罗斯(RU)、韩国(KR)、中国(CN)和日本(JP),这一时期比插入的物体早,并提供了大量具有可靠日期和地点元数据的公共领域照片。 包括公共领域、CC BY、CC BY-SA和CC0。 图像对、元数据和评价提示将公开提供。

blocks.en: Model-assisted filtering first removed violent, sexually explicit, or hateful content, then images lacking clear contextual cues indicative of their era. Of the 8,456 collected images, 3,489 (41.3%) passed filtering and proceeded to object insertion.
blocks.zh: 模式辅助过滤首先删除暴力、性暗示或仇恨内容,然后删除缺乏明确背景提示的图像,以示其时代。 在收集的8 456张图像中,有3 489张(41.3%)经过过滤,并开始反对插入。

blocks.en: Object pool construction. We drew candidates from LVIS [ 14 ] and Objects365 [ 28 ] , covering 1,203 and 365 categories. A model-assisted procedure selected objects invented or first widely adopted after 1930. Authors removed candidates with ambiguous historical status or insufficiently distinctive appearance, yielding 45 anachronistic objects.
blocks.zh: 物体池建设. 我们从LVIS[14]和Objects365[28]中抽取候选人,涉及1,203和365类。 一种模型辅助程序选择的物体在1930年后发明或首次被广泛采用. 作者开除了历史地位模糊或外表不明显的候选人,产生了45个不合时宜的目标。

blocks.en: Object–image matching and compositing. For each image, the model selected the most contextually appropriate anachronistic object and inserted it at a physically plausible location, preserving the photograph’s appearance and style.
blocks.zh: 对象 - 图像匹配和堆肥 。 对于每个图像,模型选择了最适合背景的不合时宜的物体,并将其插入一个实际可行的位置,保留照片的外观和风格。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Human Validation
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 人类验证

blocks.en: A shared pool of five annotators familiar with the relevant historical and national contexts reviewed composite quality and plausibility. Two distinct annotators reviewed each country’s candidates; assignments could overlap across countries. Each image was reviewed by exactly two annotators and retained only if both accepted all criteria. Of 3,489 candidates, 1,600 were retained. Cohen’s κ \kappa was 0.781, with 89.1% agreement (Appendix C.1 ). Annotators checked historical incompatibility, placement, scale and perspective, color and photographic style, and visible compositing artifacts; failure on any criterion led to rejection. Disagreements mainly concerned object size and placement.
blocks.zh: 一个由熟悉相关历史和国家背景的5名注释员组成的共享库审查了综合质量和可信度。 两个不同的注释员审查了每个国家的候选人;任务在各国之间可能重叠。 每幅图都经过了两名确切的注释员的审查,只有在两者都接受所有标准的情况下才予以保留。 在3 489名候选人中,保留了1 600人。 Cohen's $\kappa为0.781,协议率为89.1%(附录C.1 )。 注释者检查了历史的不兼容性、位置、规模和视角、颜色和摄影风格以及明显的混凝土文物;任何标准的失败都导致了拒绝。 分歧主要涉及物体大小和放置.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluate Inserted Object Perception (IOP), Era-Country Consistency (ECC), and Conditional Era-Country Consistency (cECC). Each question appends “Please answer yes or no,” supporting straightforward quantitative evaluation [ 10 , 20 ] . For IOP/ECC, a pair is correct only if both original and edited images are answered correctly, preventing success by repeating the same answer.
blocks.zh: 我们评价插入对象感知(IOP)、时代-国家一致性(ECC)和有条件的时代-国家一致性(CECC)。 每个问题附件 “请回答是或否”,支持直接量化评价[10、20]。 对IOP/ECC来说,一对只有在原始和编辑的图像都得到正确回答的情况下才正确,通过重复同样的答案阻止成功.
(b) 国家

blocks.en: Figure 2: Dataset analysis. (a) Joint distribution of 1,600 benchmark pairs by country (inner ring) and decade (outer ring). (b) Per-country distribution of anachronistic objects grouped by category.
blocks.zh: 图2:数据集分析。 (a) 按国家(内环)和十年(外环)共同分配1 600对基准。 (b) 按类别分类的过时物体的各国分布情况。

blocks.en: • IOP : “Is there a {object} in the image?” The ground truth is No for the original and Yes for the anachronistic image. • ECC : “Given the stated setting of {country} during {period}, is this scene consistent with that time and place?” The ground truth is Yes for the original and No for the anachronistic image. • cECC : To evaluate consistency judgments after successful object perception, we compute the proportion of IOP-correct anachronistic images judged inconsistent with the setting. Its model-specific denominator counts edited images answered correctly on IOP. An incorrect ECC answer on them is a false consistency judgment. ECC asks about the whole scene so that the model must select the relevant evidence. The inserted object provides the temporal inconsistency; country and period specify the historical setting. The edits manipulate only temporal compatibility; country is supplied as context, so ECC does not separately measure geographic consistency.
blocks.zh: • IOP:“图像中是否有{对象}?” 根本真理是否定原始的,是否定不合时宜的形象。 • ECC:“考虑到{国}在{期间}的设置,这一场景是否与该时间和地点一致?” 事实真相是,原作是肯定的,不合时宜的形象是否定的。 · cECC :为了在对象感知成功后评价一致性判断,我们计算被判定与设定不一致的IOP正确过时图像的比例. 它的模型特定分母计数在 IOP 上正确回答了编辑过的图像. 对他们不正确的ECC答案是错误的一致判断. ECC询问整个场景,以便模型必须选择相关的证据. 插入的对象提供时间不一致;国家和时期指定历史背景。 编辑器只操纵时间兼容性;国家作为上下文提供,因此ECC不单独测量地域一致性.

blocks.en: IOP : “Is there a {object} in the image?” The ground truth is No for the original and Yes for the anachronistic image.
blocks.zh: IOP:“图像中是否有{对象}?” 根本真理是否定原始的,是否定不合时宜的形象。

blocks.en: ECC : “Given the stated setting of {country} during {period}, is this scene consistent with that time and place?” The ground truth is Yes for the original and No for the anachronistic image.
blocks.zh: ECC :“考虑到{国家}在{期间}的设置,这个场景是否与该时间和地点一致?” 事实真相是,原作是肯定的,不合时宜的形象是否定的。

blocks.en: cECC : To evaluate consistency judgments after successful object perception, we compute the proportion of IOP-correct anachronistic images judged inconsistent with the setting. Its model-specific denominator counts edited images answered correctly on IOP. An incorrect ECC answer on them is a false consistency judgment.
blocks.zh: cECC : 为了在对象感知成功后评价一致性判断,我们计算被判定不符合设定的 IOP 正确过时图像的比例. 它的模型特定分母计数在 IOP 上正确回答了编辑过的图像. 对他们不正确的ECC答案是错误的一致判断.

blocks.en: 3.3 Dataset Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集分析

blocks.en: AnachroBench contains 1,600 pairs (3,200 images) across eight countries and six decades. Germany and the United States are the largest subsets, and the 1900s are most densely represented (Figure 2a ). Wikimedia Commons and LoC are the primary sources.
blocks.zh: Anachro Bench包含1,600对(3,200幅图像),分布于8个国家和60年. 德国和美国是最大的子集,1900年代代表最密集(图2a). 维基媒体共同和LoC是主要来源.

blocks.en: The 45 inserted objects follow a long-tail distribution shaped by human validation, from 115 pairs (golf cart) to one (CD player). Country-specific distributions reflect source scenes, contextually plausible object matching, and human acceptance (Figure 2b ).
blocks.zh: 45个插入的物体遵循人类验证形成的长尾分布,从115对(高尔夫推车)到1对(CD播放器). 针对具体国家的分布反映了源场景,背景上合理的对象匹配,以及人类接受(图2b.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Table 2: Performance comparison across all eight countries on IOP and ECC (%). Bold and underline indicate the best and second-best model results in each column.
blocks.zh: 图表 2: 所有8个国家在综合业务方案与ECC方面的业绩比较(%)。 粗体并下划线表示每栏的最佳和第二最佳模式结果。

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluated four closed-source models—GPT-4o [ 25 ] , Claude-Sonnet-4.5 [ 2 ] , and Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro [ 7 ] —and 14 open-source models: InstructBLIP-7B/13B [ 8 ] , mPLUG-Owl2-7B [ 33 ] , LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B [ 21 ] , CogVLM2-19B [ 16 ] , Llama-3.2-11B-Vision (Llama-3.2-11B) [ 12 ] , Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B [ 3 ] , Gemma3-4B/12B/27B [ 11 ] , and InternVL3.5-8B/14B [ 31 ] . As a human reference, three independent evaluators, unaffiliated with the benchmark construction process, each assessed the same 40 image pairs per country; Tables 2 – 3 report their average performance.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了四个闭源模型——GPT-4o [25],Claude-Sonnet-4.5 [2],和双子座2.5-Flash/Pro [7]——和14个开源模型: 指令BLIP-7B/13B [8],mPLUG-Owl2-7B [33],LLaVA-1.5-7B/13B [21],CogVLM2-19B [16],Llama-3.2-11B-Vision [12],Quen2.5-VL-3B/7B [3],Gemma3-4B/12B/27B [11],以及InternVL3.5-8B/14B [31]. 作为人类的参考,三名独立评估员,他们与基准构建过程无关,每人对每个国家相同的40对图像进行了评估;表2-3报告了他们的平均业绩。

blocks.en: Table 3: Country-wise and overall Conditional Era-Country Consistency (%).
blocks.zh: 表3:国情和总体国情一致性(%)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: Results on Inserted Object Perception . Table 2 shows Llama-3.2-11B attaining the highest IOP in most countries. Open-source models perform comparably to closed-source models, and increasing model size within a family does not consistently improve IOP.
blocks.zh: 表2显示Llama-3.2-11 B 达到大多数国家最高综合业务方案。 开源模型的性能与闭源模型的性能相当,一个家族内部不断增大的模型大小并不能持续改善IOP.

blocks.en: Results on Era-Country Consistency . ECC is markedly lower than IOP for most models (Table 2 ; Appendices E.1 and E.6 ). Closed-source systems generally outperform open-source systems, with Gemini leading most countries. GPT-4o falls well below its own IOP; InstructBLIP is near zero; and Llama-3.2-11B remains weak despite its strong perception. Thus, recognizing an object does not ensure a correct judgment about its historical context.
blocks.zh: 大纪元-国家一致性的结果 大多数模型的ECC明显低于IOP(表2;附录E.1和E.6). 闭源系统一般比开源系统要好,双子座领先大多数国家. GPT-4o远远低于自己的IOP;IstructBLIP接近于零;Llama-32-11B尽管有强烈的认知,但仍然很弱. 因此,承认一个物体并不能确保对它的历史背景作出正确的判断。

blocks.en: Results on Conditional Era-Country Consistency . On IOP-correct edited images (Table 3 ), both Gemini variants exceed 91% overall cECC, whereas most open-source models remain below 50%. False consistency judgments therefore persist after successful perception, when models must relate the perceived object to the historical setting.
blocks.zh: 有条件的时代与国家一致性的结果 在 IOP 校正的图像上(表3),双子座两种变体都超过了91%的整体cECC,而大多数开源模型仍然低于50%. 因此,错误的一致性判断在成功感知之后继续存在,模型必须将所感知的对象与历史背景联系起来。

blocks.en: Table 4: Country-wise and overall conditional consistency accuracy (%) on historically consistent controls, computed on edited images whose inserted era-appropriate object was perceived correctly.
blocks.zh: 表4: 以往一致控制上的国家和总体条件一致性精确度(%),在经过编辑的图像上计算,其插入的适时代对象被正确认为正确。

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析

blocks.en: Figure 3: Object-level conditional ECC failure rates for the four closed-source models across the 20 most challenging inserted objects.
blocks.zh: 图3:20个最具有挑战性的插入对象的四种闭源模型的客体级有条件ECC故障率.

blocks.en: Historically Consistent Control. To test whether models reject edited images because of the edit itself, we constructed 572 historically consistent images using the same pipeline and 23 era-appropriate objects across eight countries. Human validation achieved κ = 0.687 \kappa=0.687 (Appendices D and F ). Once the object is perceived, the four closed-source models accept 84.3–99.6% of era-appropriate insertions (Table 4 ) but reject 73.8–92.2% of anachronistic ones (Table 3 ), suggesting that rejection is not driven by the edit alone.
blocks.zh: 历史上一贯的控制。 为了测试模型是否因为编辑本身而拒绝经过编辑的图像,我们利用同一管道和八个国家的23个适合时代的物体构建了572幅历史上一致的图像。 人类验证达到 = 0.687\kappa= 0.687 (附录D和F). 一旦发现对象,四个闭源模型就接受84.3-99.6%的适时代插入(表4),但拒绝73.8-92.2%的不合时代模式(表3),这表明拒绝并非仅由编辑驱动。

blocks.en: Object-Level Variation. Figure 3 reports cECC failure rates for the four closed-source models on the 20 most challenging objects. Difficulty varies substantially: all four perform poorly on Frisbee (32 benchmark pairs) and Pegboard (6). Averaged over all 18 models (Appendix E.6 ), traffic cones reach 92.8% IOP but 20.1% cECC, whereas helicopters reach 96.2% and 59.9%.
blocks.zh: 对象级变异. 图3报告了20个最具挑战性的物体上的4个闭源模型的cECC故障率. 难度差异很大:所有四个都表现不佳的Frisbee(32个基准对)和Pegboard(6). 在所有18种型号(附录E.6)中,平均交通锥达到92.8%的IOP,但为20.1%的cECC,而直升机则达到96.2%和59.9%。

blocks.en: Table 5: Conditional ECC (%) on 432 accepted gpt-image-1.5 composites for six of the 11 rerun models; denominators vary by model.
blocks.zh: 表5:在11个重运行模型中的6个模型中,432个被接受的gpt-image-1.5复合材料上的有条件ECC(%);分母因模型而异.

blocks.en: Table 6: cECC (%) on country-balanced subsets. N N is before IOP conditioning; denominators vary by model. Bold: column best.
blocks.zh: 表6:国家平衡子集的cECC(%)。 N N在IOP条件之前;分母因型号而异. 粗体:专栏最好.

blocks.en: Cross-Compositor Robustness. Replacing Gemini compositing with gpt-image-1.5 yielded 689 regenerated pairs, of which both annotators accepted 432. Table 6 reports six of the 11 rerun models (full results in Appendix E.2 ). Gemini variants again rank highest among all 11, indicating that the performance pattern persists with a different compositor. Source photographs, objects, metadata, prompts, and scoring were unchanged; validation agreement was 88.2% ( κ = 0.728 \kappa=0.728 ). ECC labels follow from archive metadata and the post-1930 object criterion under human validation; however, this swap covers only compositing, so effects of model-assisted filtering, classification, and object selection may remain.
blocks.zh: 交叉组合符 坚固. 用gpt-image-1.5取代双子座堆肥,产生了689对再生成的对,其中两位注释员都接受了432对. 表6报告了11个重新运行的模型中的6个(附录E.2中的全部结果)。 双子座变体再次在所有11个变体中排名最高,表明性能模式与不同的混成体持续存在. 源照片,对象,元数据,提示和评分没有改变;验证协议为88.2%(ob = 0.728\kappa=0.728). ECC标签遵循了档案元数据和人类验证下的1930年后对象标准;然而,这种互换只涵盖堆肥,因此模型辅助过滤,分类和对象选择的效果可能依然存在.

blocks.en: Country-Balanced Robustness. Using stored predictions, we formed subsets with 40 pairs per country for Gemini composites ( N = 320 N=320 ) and 25 for GPT composites ( N = 200 N=200 ), the latter limited by accepted CN/JP pairs. Gemini variants retain the highest cECC on both (Table 6 ); this checks aggregate robustness, not country-specific judgments.
blocks.zh: 乡村-巴兰西德强壮. 利用存储的预测,我们形成子集,双子集各国40对双子集(N=320N=320),GPT复合集(N=200N=200)25对,后者受公认的CN/JP对的限制. 双子体变体在二者中都保留了最高的CECC(表6),这制约了整体稳健性,而不是针对具体国家的判断.

blocks.en: Evidence Elicitation.
blocks.zh: 证义释义.

blocks.en: Table 7: Inserted-object mentions among correct/incorrect ECC responses on the 84 hard pairs. A dash indicates no correct response.
blocks.zh: 表7:84对硬拷贝的正确/不正确ECC反应中插入的对象。 破折号表示没有正确反应。

blocks.en: Table 8: Setting MCQ and Evidence ECC (%) on 84 hard pairs. Both: correct country and period. Model names are abbreviated.
blocks.zh: 表8:84对硬拷贝的MCQ和证据ECC(%)。 两者:正确的国家和时期。 模型名称缩写.

blocks.en: To examine the use of object evidence, we selected 84 hard pairs where all six selected models passed both IOP questions and original-image ECC, but at least four failed edited-image ECC. On each edited image, models returned a yes/no ECC judgment, an Evidence field, and a one-sentence Reason ; Evidence ECC scores only the yes/no judgment. We checked object mentions by name, synonym, or clear visual description using keyword/synonym matching and manual verification (Table 8 ; Appendix E.3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了检查对象证据的使用,我们选择了84个硬对,其中所有6个选取的模型都通过了IOP问题和原始图像ECC,但至少4个失败的编辑图像ECC. 每个经编辑的图像上,模型返回了“是/否”ECC判决、“证据领域”和“一个判决理由”;“证据ECC”只得到“是/否”的判断。 我们通过关键词/同义词的匹配和人工核查,检查了对象的名称、同义词或清晰的视觉描述(表8;附录E.3)。

blocks.en: The object appears in 165/175 correct responses (94.3%) but only 28/329 incorrect responses (8.5%). Llama-3.2-11B mentions it in 20/83 incorrect responses, treating it as compatible or answering Yes after noting inconsistency. Correct judgments are strongly associated with using object evidence, although identifying it alone does not ensure a correct decision. Because all six models passed IOP on these pairs, these errors suggest that the perceived object is often not used in the whole-scene judgment.
blocks.zh: 该天体在165/175正确答复中出现(94.3%),但只有28/329不正确答复(8.5%)。 拉玛-3.2-11 B在20/83不正确的答复中提到了它,将其视为兼容性或回答是的。 正确的判决与使用客观证据密切相关,虽然单凭确定证据并不能确保作出正确的决定。 由于所有6种模型都通过这些对子上的IOP,这些错误表明感知对象在全景判断中常常不被使用.

blocks.en: Table 9: cECC (%) under the original prompt and two same-polarity paraphrases on the same 160 IOP-correct pairs (20 per country).
blocks.zh: 表9:在原速率下使用cECC(百分比),在同一160对IOP正确配对(每个国家20对)上使用两个同极化参数。

blocks.en: Table 10: Pairwise ECC (%) on 84 hard pairs, without/with object-timing information. Differences are computed from counts.
blocks.zh: 表10:84个硬对上的对等ECC(百分比),不提供/带有对对象进行计算的信息。 差异是根据计数计算的。

blocks.en: Setting Identification. Table 8 compares country/period identification through three-option multiple-choice questions (MCQs) on original images, using visual evidence alone, with Evidence ECC on edited images from the same 84 hard pairs. Country distractors are two other benchmark countries; period distractors are a nearby historical period and a modern period.
blocks.zh: 设定身份 表8比较了国家/期间在原始图像上通过三种选择的多重选择问题(MCQs)进行识别的情况,仅使用视觉证据,证据ECC则用同一84对硬拷贝图像进行编辑。 国家分心国是另外两个基准国;时期分心国是附近的历史时期和现代时期.

blocks.en: Country accuracy exceeds period accuracy by 15.5–40.5 points for every model. GPT-4o identifies both in 66.7% of cases but reaches only 28.6% Evidence ECC, suggesting distinct challenges in identifying a setting and applying it to consistency judgments.
blocks.zh: 国家精度超过每个模型的时间精度15.5–40.5分. GPT-4o确定了66.7%的案件,但只达到了28.6%的证据ECC,这表明在确定一个环境并将其应用于一致性判断方面存在明显的挑战。

blocks.en: ECC Prompt Sensitivity. We sampled 20 pairs/country from 954 pairs where all six models passed both IOP questions, yielding 160 pairs selected independently of ECC. We tested the original prompt and two same-polarity paraphrases, fixing images, metadata, labels, and yes/no format (templates in Appendix E.5 ). Under Paraphrase 1, five models change by at most 2.5 points and CogVLM2-19B by 10.6. The largest Paraphrase 2 changes are 13.8 for Llama-3.2-11B and 8.1 for CogVLM2-19B (Table 10 ). Stability varies by model; Yes means consistent in all three prompts, so affirmative bias is untested.
blocks.zh: ECC 即时敏感. 我们从954对样本中抽取了20对/国家,所有6种模型都通过了两个IOP问题,结果产生了160对独立于ECC选择的. 我们测试了原始的即时和两个同极化的参数,即固定图像、元数据、标签和是/否格式(附录E.5中的模板)。 根据第1句,5种模型在最多2.5点时变化,CogVLM2-19B在10.6点时变化. 最大的第2句修改是Llama-3.2-11B的13.8,CogVLM2-19B的8.1(表10)。 稳定性因模式而异; " 是 " 表示在所有三个提示中保持一致,因此肯定的偏向没有经过测试。

blocks.en: Object-Timing Knowledge Note. On the same 84 pairs, we added the object name and invention or widespread-adoption period to both ECC questions, using benchmark metadata cross-checked against Wikipedia. All other inputs and scoring were unchanged. Table 10 reports pairwise ECC: both images must be answered correctly (Appendix E.4 ).
blocks.zh: 对象图示知识说明. 在同一84对上,我们在两个ECC问题中都加入了对象名称和发明或广泛采用期,使用基准元数据对照维基百科进行交叉检查. 所有其他投入和评分没有变化。 表10报告双向ECC:必须正确回答这两个图像(附录E.4)。

blocks.en: GPT-4o improves from 10.7% to 92.9%, and both Gemini models exceed 91%. InternVL3.5-14B improves more modestly, whereas Llama-3.2-11B remains unchanged and CogVLM2-19B declines. Explicit timing information thus resolves most hard pairs for GPT-4o and the Gemini models but not for Llama-3.2-11B or CogVLM2-19B, suggesting that models differ in using supplied object timing; this selected subset, however, does not separate missing knowledge from evidence selection.
blocks.zh: GPT-4o从10.7%提高到92.9%,双子座模型均超过91%. InternVL3.5-14B的改善较为适度,而Llama-32-11B则保持不变,CogVLM2-19B下降. 因此,明确的时间信息解决了大多数GPT-4o和双子座模型的硬配对,但Llama-3.2-11B或CogVLM2-19B则不解决,这表明模型在使用所提供对象的时间上有所不同;然而,这个选定的子集并没有将缺失的知识与证据选择区分开来.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced AnachroBench, a benchmark for evaluating historical consistency through controlled modern-object insertions into historical images. Comprising 1,600 image pairs from eight countries, it evaluates Inserted Object Perception (IOP), Era-Country Consistency (ECC), and Conditional Era-Country Consistency (cECC). Across 14 open-source and four closed-source LVLMs, we find that strong object perception does not necessarily lead to correct era-country consistency judgments, particularly for open-source models. Further analyses show substantial variation across inserted objects, while cross-compositor and country-balanced analyses indicate that the main performance differences persist. On the selected hard pairs, evidence and setting analyses suggest that models often struggle to apply perceived object evidence to the setting. Overall, AnachroBench provides a targeted diagnostic of false consistency judgments by separating inserted-object perception from historical-context judgments.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Anachro Bench,通过在历史图像中插入受控制的现代物体来评价历史一致性的基准. 由来自8个国家的1,600对图像组成,它评价了插入对象感知(IOP)、时代-国家一致性(ECC)和有条件的时代-国家一致性(cECC)。 在14个开放源代码和4个封闭源代码LVLM中,我们发现强对象感知并不一定导致正确的时代国家一致性判断,特别是对于开放源代码模型. 进一步的分析显示,插入的物体之间有很大差异,而交叉组合体和国家平衡的分析则表明,主要业绩差异依然存在。 关于选定的硬配对,证据和设定分析表明,模型往往难以将感知到的物体证据用于设定。 总体而言,Anachro Bench通过将插入对象感知与历史文本判断区分开来,对虚假一致性判断提供了有针对性的诊断.

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: AnachroBench is limited to eight countries and images from 1870–1929; it neither represents the full range of historical settings nor measures failure rates in spontaneous free-form generation. We also restrict the object pool to high-confidence temporal incompatibilities, objects invented or first widely adopted after 1930. We did not verify country-specific adoption timelines, so the benchmark omits subtler cases whose anachronicity depends on regional diffusion. Covering those would require expert historical annotation. The binary format supports consistent quantitative evaluation but does not capture how models arrive at their judgments. The 45 objects are unevenly distributed because some integrate into historical scenes more plausibly than others; future versions should broaden the pool to include categories with a wider range of visual attributes. Finally, model-assisted filtering and insertion may introduce systematic biases despite the human validation used to screen the resulting images.
blocks.zh: Anachro Bench仅限于8个国家和1870–1929年的图像;它既不代表全部历史背景,也不衡量自发自由形态生成的故障率. 我们还将物体池限制在高度自信的时空不兼容,1930年后发明或首次被广泛采纳的物体. 我们没有核实具体国家的通过时间表,因此基准省略了较微妙的情况,其时间不成熟取决于区域传播。 涵盖这些需要专家的历史注释。 二进制格式支持一致的定量评价,但不能捕捉模型如何作出判断. 这45个物体分布不均,因为有的集成于历史场景中,比其他的更合理;未来版本应该拓宽集合范围,以包括具有更广泛的视觉属性的类别. 最后,模型辅助过滤和插入可能会带来系统性的偏见,尽管在筛选所产生的图像时使用了人类验证。

blocks.en: System: You are a strict historical photo curator. Output only a single JSON object, no markdown.
blocks.zh: 系统:你是一个严格的历史摄影师。 只输出一个 JSON 对象, 不减值 。

blocks.en: User: Evaluate the image based on the geographic region label: {region_label} . Must not contain any graphic violence, dead or injured persons, executions, armed children, child soldiers, or any other disturbing, exploitative content. Decide if ALL the following criteria are clearly met based on VISIBLE evidence: 1) Region Match: The scene must match the labeled region/country ( {region_label} ) through architecture, signage, landscape, or cultural cues. 2) Era Window: The depicted era must fall between {year_min} and {year_max} . 3) Attire as Temporal Cues: Visible clothing must clearly align with the {year_min} – {year_max} era.
blocks.zh: 用户:根据地理区域标签评价图像:{region_label}. 不得含有任何生动暴力、死伤人员、处决、武装儿童、儿童兵或任何其他令人不安的剥削内容。 根据现有证据,决定是否全部符合下列标准: 1) 区域匹配 : 该场景必须通过建筑,标志,景观,或文化提示来匹配被标记的区域/国家({region_label}). 2) 大纪元窗口 : 描绘的时代必须在 {year_min} 和 {year_max} 之间下降 。 3)服饰为Temperal Cues:显式服饰必须与{year_min}–{year_max}时代明显一致.

blocks.en: C.1 Inter-Annotator Agreement
blocks.zh: C.1 书记员 协议

blocks.en: Table 11 reports agreement for the human validation stage. Country-level κ \kappa ranges from 0.544 to 0.953, spanning moderate to almost perfect agreement on the Landis–Koch scale [ 19 ] ; the lowest estimate is for China ( n = 136 n=136 ). Only candidates independently accepted by both annotators entered the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表11 人类验证阶段报告协议. 国家一级的 \ kappa 介于 0. 544 至 0.953 之间, 在 Landis- Koch 比例尺 [19] 上跨越中度或几乎完美的协议; 最低的估计数是中国(n = 136 n = 136 )。 只有两个注释员独立接受的候选人才进入基准。

blocks.en: Annotators first verified that the inserted object was incompatible with the stated era and country. They then checked its placement, scale and perspective, color and photographic style, and any visible compositing artifacts. Failure on any criterion resulted in rejection. Disagreements arose mainly on the visual criteria, most often the object’s size and placement. Historical incompatibility was rarely at issue, since the post-1930 pool leaves it unambiguous. We report this qualitatively rather than as counts.
blocks.zh: 注释者首先核实插入的对象与所述时代和国家不符. 他们随后检查了它的放置、规模和视角、颜色和摄影风格以及任何可见的混凝土文物。 任何标准都不符合,结果被拒绝。 分歧主要在于视觉标准,通常是物体的大小和位置。 由于1930年后的池子使得它变得毫不含糊,因此历史上的不兼容之处很少引起争议。 我们从质量上而不是从数量上报告。

blocks.en: Tables 12 and 13 summarize the source- and country-wise image distributions before filtering and after filtering and human validation, respectively. Figure 8 shows the temporal distribution: 670 images (41.9%) date to 1900–1909, 452 (28.3%) to before 1900, 393 (24.6%) to 1910–1919, and 85 (5.3%) to the 1920s. Figure 9 gives the frequency of all 45 objects. Golf cart occurs 115 times, jeep 99 times, and jet plane and helicopter 94 times each; CD player, beeper, marker, freshener, and dishwasher detergent occur once each.
blocks.zh: 表12和13分别汇总了过滤前和过滤后和人类验证后的来源和国别图像分布。 图8显示了时间分布:到1900-1909年时为670幅图像(41.9%),到1900年以前为452幅(28.3%),到1910-1919年时为393幅(24.6%),到1920年代为85幅(5.3%)。 图9给出了所有45个物体的频率. 高尔夫车发生115次,吉普99次,喷气式飞机和直升机每架94次;CD播放器,鸣笛器,标记器,洗涤器和洗碗器每架发生一次.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Frequency of 45 anachronistic objects across the 1,600-pair benchmark, sorted in descending order.
blocks.zh: 图9:45个不合时宜物体的频率,跨越1 600平方基准,按降序排序。

blocks.en: Appendix D Historically Consistent Image Dataset
blocks.zh: 附录D 一致的图像数据集

blocks.en: D.1 Inter-Annotator Agreement
blocks.zh: D.1 书记员 协议

blocks.en: Table 14 reports agreement for the historically consistent control set. Country-level κ \kappa ranges from 0.576 to 0.773, spanning moderate to substantial agreement on the Landis–Koch scale [ 19 ] . Only images accepted by both annotators were retained.
blocks.zh: 表14汇报了历来一致的一套控制协议。 国家一级的标准为0.576至0.773,涉及对Landis-Koch比例表的中度和实质性协议[19]。 只保留了两个注释员接受的图像。

blocks.en: Table 14: Inter-annotator agreement by country for historically consistent image validation. The 1,600 candidates were reviewed before 572 controls were selected.
blocks.zh: 表14 按国家分列的关于历史上一贯图像验证的公证员协议. 在选择572项控制措施之前,审查了1 600名候选人。

blocks.en: D.2 Dataset Statistics
blocks.zh: D.2 数据集统计

blocks.en: Figure 11 breaks down the 572 control images by country and decade; Figure 11 shows the frequencies of the 23 era-appropriate objects.
blocks.zh: 图11按国家和十年分列了572个控制图像;图11显示了23个适合时代的物体的频率。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Distribution of 572 historically consistent images by country (inner ring) and decade (outer ring).
blocks.zh: 图10:按国家(内环)和十年(外环)分布的572幅历史一贯图像.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Frequencies of 23 era-appropriate objects in 572 historically consistent images, sorted in descending order.
blocks.zh: 图11:572个历史一贯图像中23个适合时代的物体的花序,按降序排序.

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Robustness and Diagnostic Analyses
blocks.zh: 附录E 其他强健性和诊断性分析

blocks.en: The analyses below use different subsets and protocols. Their results are therefore interpreted within each stated setting rather than as direct estimates on the full benchmark.
blocks.zh: 以下分析使用不同的子集和协议. 因此,它们的结果在每一个规定的设定中被解释为全部基准的直接估计。

blocks.en: E.1 Original–Anachronistic Performance by Country
blocks.zh: E.1 原文-历史 按国家分列的业绩

blocks.en: Figure 12 compares performance on original and anachronistic images across countries. IOP changes relatively little between the two image types, whereas ECC decreases substantially on anachronistic images, particularly for several open-source models. This gap indicates that the primary difficulty emerges when models must relate perceived objects to the specified historical setting.
blocks.zh: 图12比较了各国原始和不合时宜的图像的执行情况。 两种图像类型之间的IOP变化相对较少,而ECC在不合时宜的图像上大幅下降,尤其是一些开源模型. 这一差距表明,当模型必须把可感知的物体与特定的历史背景联系起来时,就会产生主要的困难。

blocks.en: Figure 12: Radar charts illustrating the performance of selected closed- and open-source models across eight countries. The left panel presents IOP, while the right panel presents ECC. Solid lines denote performance on original images, whereas dashed lines denote performance on the corresponding anachronistic images.
blocks.zh: 图12:显示8个国家选定封闭式和开源式模型绩效的雷达图。 左面板呈现IOP,而右面板呈现ECC. 实线表示原始图像上的性能,而虚线表示相应的不合时宜图像上的性能.

blocks.en: E.2 Cross-Compositor Robustness
blocks.zh: E.2 跨部门协调员 强健性

blocks.en: To examine whether the results persist with a different compositor, we regenerated 689 pairs with gpt-image-1.5 . The source photographs, inserted objects, metadata, prompts, and scoring protocol were unchanged, and both annotators accepted 432 pairs. Agreement was 88.2% with Cohen’s κ = 0.728 \kappa=0.728 , and country-level κ \kappa ranged from 0.629 to 0.835. We reran 11 models on this set; Table 15 reports their country-wise and overall conditional ECC (cECC).
blocks.zh: 为了检查结果是否与不同的混凝土存在,我们用gpt-image-1.5重新生成689对. 原始照片、插入对象、元数据、提示和评分协议没有改变,两个注释员接受了432对。 协议为88.2%, Cohen = 0.728\kappa = 0.728, 国家一级为0.629至0.835。 我们在此套中重新提出11种模式;表15按国家和总体条件报告了这些模式。

blocks.en: Table 15: Country-wise and overall conditional ECC (%) for the 11 models rerun on 432 accepted gpt-image-1.5 composites. Scores are computed on IOP-correct edited images, giving model-specific denominators; the smallest country cells contain about 20 images.
blocks.zh: 表15:11种型号在432个已接受gpt-image-1.5复合材料上重新运行的国家和总体条件ECC(%). 分数根据IOP校正的编辑图像计算,给出模型特定分母;最小的国家单元格包含约20个图像.

blocks.en: The two Gemini models retain the highest overall cECC among the rerun models. This result is descriptive rather than an estimate of a compositor effect: image filtering, object selection, and object classification remain Gemini-assisted, and the Gemini-composited baseline was not recomputed on the same 432 items. The country cells are also much smaller than those in the full benchmark and are not used for cross-country ranking.
blocks.zh: 两个双子座模型在重新运行的模型中保留了最高的整体cECC. 这一结果是描述性的,而不是对复合物效应的估计:图像过滤,对象选择,对象分类仍然是双子座辅助的,双子座复合基线没有在同一432项上重新计算. 国别小组也比全面基准小组小得多,没有用于跨国排名。

blocks.en: E.3 Setting Identification and Evidence Elicitation
blocks.zh: E.3 确定身份和取证

blocks.en: For a closer view of false consistency judgments, we selected 84 pairs on which all six models passed IOP for both images and answered ECC correctly for the original image, but at least four failed ECC for the edited image. This shared hard subset is used for failure analysis, not to estimate full-benchmark performance.
blocks.zh: 为了更仔细地看错一致性判断,我们选择了84对,所有6个模型都通过两个图像的IOP,并正确回答ECC对原始图像的回答,但至少4对编辑图像的ECC失败. 这个共享的硬子集用于失败分析,而不是估计全基准性能.

blocks.en: Each model first answered separate three-option questions about the country and period of the original image using visual evidence alone. The country choices consist of the correct answer and two other benchmark countries; the period choices include the correct period, a nearby historical period, and a modern decoy. In a separate call on the edited image, the model returned a yes/no ECC judgment, an Evidence field, and a one-sentence Reason . Evidence ECC scores only the yes/no judgment, not the accompanying text. The two diagnostics are reported in Section 4.3 and Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 每个模型首先用视觉证据单独回答关于原始图像的国家和时期的三选项问题. 国家选择包括正确的答案和其他两个基准国家;期间选择包括正确的时期、附近的历史时期和现代诱饵。 在对编辑图像的单独呼吁中,模型返回了“是/否”ECC判决、“证据领域”和“一个判决理由”。 证据ECC只评为"是/否",而不是随附的文本. 第4.3节和表8报告了这两种诊断。

blocks.en: The setting questions and Evidence ECC use different images and response formats, so the columns of Table 8 describe complementary behavior on the selected cases rather than a common capability scale.
blocks.zh: 设置问题和证据ECC使用不同的图像和响应格式,因此表8的栏目描述了所选案件的互补行为,而不是通用的能力尺度.

blocks.en: The inserted-object mention audit on these Evidence ECC responses is reported in Section 4.3 and Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 第4.3节和表8报告了关于证据ECC答复的插入对象。

blocks.en: E.4 Object-Timing Knowledge Note
blocks.zh: E.4 物件图示知识说明

blocks.en: On the same 84 pairs, we repeated the standard pairwise ECC evaluation after adding an item-specific note to both the original- and edited-image questions. The note names the inserted object and states when it was invented or first widely adopted, using benchmark metadata cross-checked against Wikipedia. Images, questions, answer polarity, and scoring remain unchanged. Table 10 compares the original prompt (Base) with this controlled information-provision condition (Note); it does not evaluate retrieval.
blocks.zh: 在同一84对上,我们重复了标准双向ECC评价,在原图像问题和编辑图像问题中都增加了具体项目的说明。 该注释将插入的对象命名,并在被发明或首次被广泛采用时表示,使用基准元数据对照维基百科进行交叉检查. 图像,问题,答案极性,评分保持不变. 表10比较了原始的快件(Base)和这个受控的信息提供条件(注);它不评价检索.

blocks.en: With the note, pair accuracy rises from 10.7% to 92.9% for GPT-4o and reaches 91.7–92.9% for the two Gemini models. The smaller gain for InternVL3.5-14B, unchanged Llama-3.2-11B result, and decrease for CogVLM2-19B show that the response is not uniform. Because the note supplies both the object identity and its timing, the gains do not separate missing object-timing knowledge from failure to use relevant knowledge in the judgment. These pairwise ECC scores are distinct from the edited-image Evidence ECC.
blocks.zh: 随着注解,对称精度从GPT-4o的10.7%提高到92.9%,对双子座模型的双子座精度达到91.7-92.9%. InternVL3.5-14B的较小增益,不变的Llama-32-11B结果,CogVLM2-19B的减少显示反应不统一. 由于该注释既提供了对象身份,又提供了其时间,这些收益并没有将缺失的对象定时知识与判断中未能使用相关知识区分开来. 这些双向ECC分数与编辑后的图像证据ECC不同.

blocks.en: E.5 ECC Prompt Sensitivity
blocks.zh: E.5 ECC 即时敏感性

blocks.en: Table 16: ECC question templates used in the prompt-sensitivity analysis. The country and period placeholders are filled from benchmark metadata.
blocks.zh: 表16:迅速敏感性分析中使用的ECC问题模板。 国家和时期的占位符由基准元数据填充.

blocks.en: For the prompt-sensitivity analysis in Section 4.3 , we evaluate the original ECC prompt and two same-polarity paraphrases on a fixed subset of 160 pairs, 20 per country (results in Table 10 ). Table 16 provides the exact prompt templates used in this analysis.
blocks.zh: 关于第4.3节的迅速敏感性分析,我们评价了最初的ECC即时和两个同极化参数,一个固定子集160对,每个国家20对(结果见表10)。 表16提供了本分析所用的准确的即时模板。

blocks.en: E.6 Country and Object Breakdowns
blocks.zh: E.6 国家和对象细目

blocks.en: Table 17 averages results over all 18 models. Country values use the full 1,600-pair benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表17对所有18种模型的平均结果。 国家数值采用1 600平方圆的全部基准。

blocks.en: Table 17: Country- and object-level performance (%), computed per model then averaged over the 18 models. cECC is conditioned on correct object perception. Panel (b) gives the five highest- and five lowest-scoring objects among those with at least 30 pairs.
blocks.zh: 表17:国家和对象一级的业绩(%),按模型计算,然后按18个模型平均计算。 cECC以正确的对象感知为条件. (b) 在至少30对对象中给予五个最高和五个最低分的物体。

blocks.en: IOP exceeds ECC in every country, although China and Japan each contain fewer than 50 pairs. Among the retained objects, cECC ranges from 62.9% for fighter jets to 10.3% for frisbees. These descriptive aggregates neither identify the source of the errors nor support fine-grained country rankings.
blocks.zh: 每个国家的IOP都超过了ECC,虽然中国和日本各含有不到50对. 在保留的对象中,战斗机的cECC从62.9%到飞盘的10.3%。 这些描述性汇总既未指明错误的来源,也未支持经过细化的国家排名。

blocks.en: In Tables 2 – 3 , the human references come from 40 pairs per country rather than the full 1,600 pairs. Because the evaluated sets and cECC denominators differ, they serve as descriptive references rather than a ceiling.
blocks.zh: 在表2 – 3中,人类参考来源于每个国家40对而不是完整的1600对. 由于评价的成套标准与ECC分母不同,它们可作为描述性参考而不是上限。
